ValidationRule.description: Prohibit changes to Accounting Instructions once Case is Sent to Accounting
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Send_to_Accounting__c =True, Override__c = FALSE, NOT( $User.ProfileId = "00e800000014YDt"), OR( ISCHANGED( Action__c ), ISCHANGED( Amount__c ), ISCHANGED( Case__c ), ISCHANGED( Case_Status_new__c ), ISCHANGED( Case_Status__c ), ISCHANGED( Date_of_Bounce__c ), ISCHANGED( Debit_Amount__c ), ISCHANGED( Duplicate_Comments__c ), ISCHANGED( Legal_Name__c ), ISCHANGED( Loan_Number__c ), ISCHANGED( Other_Comments__c ), ISCHANGED( Payment_Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Rerun_ACH_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Resume_ACH_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Returned_Payment_Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Type__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once Accounting Instructions have been Sent to Accounting they can no longer be edited. Create new Accounting Instructions to proceed.
